findings.claim: ClientPermissionsV2 uses Arrays.asList() for single-element lists where List.of() could be used.

verifier.reason: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/ClientPermissionsV2.java:225 and :250, both private hasPermission overloads create a single-element list via Arrays.asList(scope) for non-null AdminPermissionsSchema scope constants, where List.of(scope) could be used (as already done on line 268).
